title: OpenVA MCP enrich_inventory Request
description: The wire request for the MCP enrich_inventory tool: a list of shared enrichment rows under `rows`, plus an optional source-type filter. This is transport-specific: the match-service /v1/enrich HTTP endpoint carries the SAME rows (agent-enrichment-row.schema.json) under a `vendors` array instead — a deliberate, documented adapter mapping, not a single wire schema for both. The shared, transport-neutral contract is the row in `$defs/row` (identical to agent-enrichment-row.schema.json).

rows.description: Bounded batch of vendor-identity rows. Processed in input order; duplicates are preserved.

source_types.description: Optional canonical source-type filter. Omitted (or null) means all canonical source types. An unknown type simply yields no sources for that type.

row.description: Mirror of agent-enrichment-row.schema.json: one vendor identity with an opaque row_id. At least one identity field must be non-empty (enforced by the tool).
